log.rationale: Closes the verification_channel gap: a bank account change like BA-0032 must be confirmed by an outbound callback to contact details on file before the request, before payment can execute. Inbound email, agent messages and inbound calls are excluded because an attacker can spoof them. Using contact_as_of=before_request stops an attacker from changing the contact details first. The T2 refutations show that binding fields alone cannot stop a forged change request.
